video_title: DeMar DeRozan joins The Richard Show

quotes.speaker: DeMar DeRozan
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMar DeRozan compares his playmaking evolution to Neo in the Matrix

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: A lot of players talk about the game slowing down for them as they elevate their game. Is that something that you can speak to as well as you maybe developed your playmaking in other areas of your game?

text_blocks.speaker: DeMar DeRozan
text_blocks.text: I'm like Neo now. I made a reference to me being like Neo in the Matrix now. He asked me how the game slowed down for me and I said I feel like Neo in the Matrix now.

quotes.speaker: DeMar DeRozan
quotes.summary_phrase: Diar DeRozan's defensive impact on opposing free throw shooters
quotes.excerpt: Tell your daughter to leave me alone.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: It was a time OG missed two free throws and we're running back. He said, 'Man, tell your daughter to leave me alone.' OG did that?

text_blocks.speaker: DeMar DeRozan
text_blocks.text: Yes, literally, we're in the game running back and OG says, 'Tell your daughter to stop screaming. Tell her to leave me alone. We keep missing free throws.' I'm like, 'Damn, y'all missing free throws?' So when they win again and they miss two free throws again, I'm hearing it. Throughout the game I'm hearing it and I'm like, 'Yo, this shit is working.'

quotes.speaker: DeMar DeRozan
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMar DeRozan's habit of not creasing his basketball shoes
quotes.excerpt: I never wanted to increase my shoes when I was young.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMar DeRozan
text_blocks.text: It really started because I never wanted to increase my shoes when I was young. I didn't want to tie them too tight, crease them, because my shoes on the court were my school shoes too, so I tried to keep them.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: People don't understand that you get one pair of shoes where it's the start of school, that's your first pair of shoes, that's basketball practice, that's church.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMar DeRozan
text_blocks.text: So that's where it started from and it just became like a habit and it just stayed that way.
